# gravitino_topics Data Source

Lists all topics within a Gravitino metalake, catalog, and schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_topics" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  catalog  = "kafka_catalog"
  schema   = "example_schema"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.

### Read-Only

- `topics` (Attributes List) List of topics with their details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--topics))

<a id="nestedatt--topics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `topics`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the topic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--topics--audit))
- `comment` (String) The topic comment.
- `name` (String) The topic name.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties for the topic.

<a id="nestedatt--topics--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `topics.audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
